# Front-end libraries

Served from the site's own hosting, so visitors' browsers never request anything from an external CDN. The files are unmodified copies downloaded from jsDelivr (2026-10-10).

| Folder             | Library         | Version | Source                                              | License |
| ------------------ | --------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `bootstrap/`       | Bootstrap       | 5.3.8   | `cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/`        | MIT     |
| `bootstrap-icons/` | Bootstrap Icons | 1.11.3  | `cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/font/` | MIT     |

The license notices are in the file headers. To update a library, replace its folder as a whole and change the version here.

Source map (`.map`) files are not included. Browsers request them only with the developer tools open and get a 404, which does not affect visitors.
